entities.summary: Sanchez William Genia is an Australian professional rugby union coach and former player, currently coaching with the Kintetsu Liners (花園近鉄ライナーズ) in Japan. Genia's playing position was scrum-half. He had previously played in the Super Rugby for the Queensland Reds (2007–2015) and Melbourne Rebels (2018–2019), and finished his career for the Kintetsu Liners in Japan. He also had previously played for Stade Français in France's Top 14 from 2015 to 2017.
